newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia coal price US$37.15/t in Korea deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia coal price US$37.15/t in Korea deal.

text.p: Liddell Coal Operation Pty Ltd said on Wednesday a deal reached for 1997 thermal coal exports with Korea Electric Power Co (KEPCO) was priced at US$37.15 per tonne for coal producing 6,700 kilocalories/tonne.
Liddell, a joint venture of Savage Resources Ltd and Mitsui Matsushima's Australian unit, announced the agreement earlier on Wednesday but did not release the price.

Corporate general manager Kevin Gallagher said the price represented a US$2.67 per tonne decrease from the 1996 price of US$39.82 and compared with a price of US$37.65 agreed for 1997 exports to Japan.
Liddell was the lead negotiator for Australian exporters meaning its deal with KEPCO sets the level for other exporters.
KEPCO is one of Asia's largest coal consumers with current annual consumption of 20 million tonnes. Liddell has a 10-year contract to supply 400,000 tonnes per year to KEPCO.
